description: Four complete methods for reasoning, assumption checks and framework selection with explicit recipient-owned source bindings.
name: reasoning-studio

defaultPrompt: Stress-test this claim and identify what evidence would change it.
Help me question this assumption one question at a time.
Compare the strongest credible explanations and preserve the disagreement.
interface.longDescription: Pressure-test a claim, clarify an assumption in dialogue, or compare credible explanations so the next decision rests on stronger reasoning. Check a claim against its strongest credible alternative. Work through a consequential assumption one question at a time. Audit supplied reasoning with Critical Compass and preserve evidence, uncertainty and dissent. Start with a concrete task or ask what this plugin can do. Reasoning frameworks and model agreement do not supply independent evidence. Advanced panels are an explicit mode, and human-loop questions require real user answers.
